questionText:
A geometric series has first term $a = 6$ and sum to infinity $S_\infty = 24$.

(a) Find the common ratio $r$.
(b) Find the sum of the first $5$ terms, correct to two decimal places.
markingScheme:
(a) Use $S_\infty = \dfrac{a}{1 - r}$ **(1 mark)**
(a) Solve $24 = \dfrac{6}{1-r}$ to get $r = \tfrac{3}{4}$ **(2 marks)**
(b) Use $S_n = \dfrac{a(1 - r^n)}{1 - r}$ **(1 mark)**
(b) Substitute correctly **(1 mark)**
(b) Final answer $S_5 \approx 18.30$ **(1 mark)**
